Hi Markus,

Thanks for taking this — Acme's SOC/SIG review team flagged a few items in our questionnaire around documented execution of rolling patch campaigns and proof that high-severity CVEs closed within your 90-day SLA. Specifically they're asking for:

- A consumable log showing the rolling patch waves (dates, affected instances/images) for the last quarter
- Evidence artifacts for CVEs assigned a Triage:High in the period (ticket references, commit hashes, timelines showing remediation steps)
- Confirmation that emergency/exception handling followed your documented SLA (if any exceptions, please include RCA)

Can you provide the log+attestation and a short narrative we can include in the SIG response? Ideally a single PDF and the CSV log.
